uncertain.note: note key k has no visible {k} marker anywhere in the body. Every line of the first paragraph was examined at 3-4x; lines 4-6 ('ne ſoit ſu-' / 'collo-' / 'ni violen'), where the note sits, show no raised italic letter. Either the marker failed to print or it was lost at the line end. Marker k recorded as missing.

at 10x the sorts after 'penu' read l (tall ascender), t (short ascender with crossbar), dotted i, round s, dotted i, hyphen, giving 'penultisi-' + 'me' = 'penultisime'. At lower magnification the l/t pair can read as a single l ('penulisi-'). The expected citation is 'c. penultime de prob.' (cf. 'l. penultime.' elsewhere), so the printed form is odd either way. Escalated for the reconciler.

the line-end hyphen after 'tranſ' is barely inked: a faint speck at mid height, far lighter than the clean hyphen of 'lite-' on the next line. Transcribed as a hyphen; it could equally be a break with no hyphen (§1, which needs no entry) or a stray mark.

uncertain.text: terét le mariage: des robes, & veſtemens,
uncertain.note: 'terét': the mark over the second e is a straight stroke rising to the right, i.e. an acute, matching the acute of 'tré:' two lines below; the sense ('traiterent') would want a tilde 'terẽt'. Read as printed acute.

uncertain.text: tant au iour des nopces, que deuant &
uncertain.note: '&' is printed at the end of this line and again at the start of the next ('& apres.'), so the ampersand is set twice. Transcribed as printed; sic, not a reading doubt.
